2. Sedigraph & Component Separation Functions
```{r}
separate_melt_rework_rain <- function(df, r_col, year = NULL, win_short = 5, win_long = 15) {
  r_var <- enquo(r_col)
  
  df_proc <- df
  if (!is.null(year)) {
    df_proc <- df_proc %>% filter(year(time) == as.numeric(year))
  }
  df_proc <- df_proc %>% filter(!is.na(!!r_var))
  
  if (nrow(df_proc) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df_result <- df_proc %>%
    mutate(tod = format(time, "%H:%M")) %>%
    group_by(tod) %>%
    arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Short window: captures amplified diurnal peaks post-floods
      R_diurnal_fast = rollapply(!!r_var, width = win_short, FUN = median, 
                                 align = "center", partial = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Long window: captures baseline climatic ablation
      R_diurnal_slow = rollapply(!!r_var, width = win_long, FUN = median, 
                                 align = "center", partial = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(time) %>%
    mutate(
      # 1. Clean climatic ablation (lowest envelope)
      R_melt = pmin(!!r_var, R_diurnal_slow, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # 2. Channel rework (difference between fast diurnal median and melt baseline)
      R_rework_raw = pmin(!!r_var, R_diurnal_fast, na.rm = TRUE) - R_melt,
      R_rework = pmax(0, R_rework_raw),
      
      # 3. Direct rainfall / debris-flow peak
      R_storm = pmax(0, !!r_var - R_melt - R_rework)
    ) %>%
    select(-tod, -R_diurnal_fast, -R_diurnal_slow, -R_rework_raw)
  
  return(df_result)
}

Plot_melt_rework_sedigraph <- function(sedigraph_env, YEAR, GAUGE) {
  
  if (is.null(sedigraph_env) || nrow(sedigraph_env) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df_plot <- sedigraph_env %>%
    select(time, R_melt, R_rework, R_storm) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(R_melt, R_rework, R_storm), 
      names_to = "Component", 
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Component = factor(
        Component, 
        levels = c("R_storm", "R_rework", "R_melt"), # Stack order (top to bottom)
        labels = c(
          "Rainstorm / debris-flow peaks", 
          "Sediment reworking", 
          "Baseline glacial ablation"
        )
      )
    )
  
  tz_val <- attr(df_plot$time, "tzone")
  if (is.null(tz_val)) tz_val <- "UTC"
  
  start_date <- as.POSIXct(paste0(YEAR, "-06-01 00:00:00"), tz = tz_val)
  end_date   <- as.POSIXct(paste0(YEAR, "-09-15 23:59:59"), tz = tz_val)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = time, y = Value, fill = Component)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Baseline glacial ablation"     = "#4682B4", # Steel Blue
        "Sediment reworking"            = "#D2691E", # Chocolate/Ochre
        "Rainstorm / debris-flow peaks" = "#DC143C"  # Crimson
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_datetime(
      limits = c(start_date, end_date),
      date_breaks = "5 days",          
      minor_breaks = "1 day",          
      date_labels = "%d.%m",
      expand = c(0.01, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(YEAR, ', ', GAUGE, ' — Channel Sediment Dynamics'),
      subtitle = "Separation of sediment exhaustion phases and runoff components",
      x = "Date (day.month)",
      y = "Sediment load (kg/s)",
      fill = "Runoff components:"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Example execution for Djankuat (2025):
p_djan25_example <- Plot_melt_rework_sedigraph(
  sedigraph_env = separate_melt_rework_rain(
    df = sedigraph_smooth, 
    r_col = R_djan2025, 
    year = 2025, 
    win_short = 10,   # Flood adaptation window (days)
    win_long = 90     # Pure baseline ablation window (days)
  ),
  YEAR = 2025,
  GAUGE = 'Djankuat'
)

print(p_djan25_example)
```

3. Sediment Proportion Analysis & Visualization
```{r}
Calculate_sediment_proportions <- function(df, r_col, year, gauge, win_short = 10, win_long = 90) {
  
  sep_df <- separate_melt_rework_rain(
    df = df, 
    r_col = {{ r_col }}, 
    year = year, 
    win_short = win_short, 
    win_long = win_long
  )
  
  if (is.null(sep_df) || nrow(sep_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  tz_val <- attr(sep_df$time, "tzone")
  if (is.null(tz_val)) tz_val <- "UTC"
  
  start_date <- as.POSIXct(paste0(year, "-06-01 00:00:00"), tz = tz_val)
  end_date   <- as.POSIXct(paste0(year, "-09-15 23:59:59"), tz = tz_val)
  
  res_filtered <- sep_df %>% filter(time >= start_date & time <= end_date)
  
  if (nrow(res_filtered) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  res <- res_filtered %>%
    summarise(
      `Sediment reworking` = sum(R_rework, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
      `Baseline glacial ablation` = sum(R_melt, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
      `Rainstorm / debris-flow peaks` = sum(R_storm, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(), 
      names_to = "Component", 
      values_to = "Mass_tons"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Year = factor(year),
      Gauge = gauge,
      Percent = if (sum(Mass_tons) > 0) Mass_tons / sum(Mass_tons) * 100 else 0,
      Component = factor(
        Component, 
        levels = c("Rainstorm / debris-flow peaks", "Sediment reworking", "Baseline glacial ablation")
      )
    )
  
  return(res)
}

# Calculate summary dataset for pie charts:
df_summary <- bind_rows(
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2025, 2025, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2023, 2023, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2020, 2020, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2019, 2019, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2017, 2017, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2016, 2016, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_djan2015, 2015, 'Djankuat', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_tyrnauz,  2025, 'Baksan, Tyrnyauz', 10, 90),
  Calculate_sediment_proportions(sedigraph_smooth, R_zayukovo, 2025, 'Baksan, Zayukovo', 10, 90)
)

# Plot pie chart matrix:
p_pies <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = "", y = Percent, fill = Component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(Percent > 4, paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%"), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Gauge ~ Year, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Baseline glacial ablation"     = "#4682B4", # Steel Blue
      "Sediment reworking"            = "#D2691E", # Chocolate/Ochre
      "Rainstorm / debris-flow peaks" = "#DC143C"  # Crimson
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Sediment Runoff Components by Gauge and Year",
    subtitle = "Calculation for the period June 01 - September 15",
    fill = "Runoff components:"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", angle = 270),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

print(p_pies)
```
